records: Production emit_signal.py is a news/LLM sentiment classifier with an equal-weight fallback blend, not a price-targeted XRP forecast; it has no explicit horizon and no order-book, on-chain, derivatives, ETF, stablecoin, collateral or macro feature ingestion.

At main 34722b7, web/signal_history.jsonl is empty while web/signal_accuracy.json claims 1,683 checked, 772 correct and 45.9%; the current repository cannot reproduce the legacy summary from its designated input. Historical records may have existed in an earlier revision; the discrepancy does not prove fabrication.

The separate data/signal_ledger.jsonl contains only 45 XRP/USD records from July 4-7, all NULL, maximum confidence 0.317, degraded sentiment and no fixed-horizon realized outcomes; it is not a training or evaluation dataset.

core/hrm_ternary.py explicitly has no trained weights; its confidence is a deterministic agreement-times-convergence heuristic and is not calibrated probability. The inspected production signal generator does not integrate it.

The active Knowledge Signal Cycle is manual workflow_dispatch-only but has contents:write and commits/pushes generated knowledge and signal files directly to main. PR #1379 does not alter this manual write path.

CoinDesk's October 30 market snapshot combines the Binance security event with contemporaneous technology-equity weakness; the relative causal contribution of each shock to XRP and broad crypto returns has not been isolated.
The Block's XRP -7% figure is a dated secondary 22:00 ET October 29 observation; it is not a current quote and should not be combined with later price snapshots without time alignment.
No fixed-horizon XRP outcome labels, walk-forward results, baseline comparisons or calibrated probabilities are currently verified; forecast status remains NOT_ISSUED.
